description: Ordered numeric comparisons between two numbers: strictly-less-than, less-than-or-equal, strictly-greater-than, and greater-than-or-equal. Each relation is satisfied when the actual number stands in the named order to the expected number (the inclusive variants also accept equality) and otherwise reports a violation whose diagnostic names the comparison and both numbers. Both operands must be numbers; if either is not a number the request is rejected with a neutral error category instead of being compared.

cases.expected_output:
check=less_than
outcome=violation
message=Expected 3 to be less than 2

check=less_than_or_equal
outcome=violation
message=Expected 3 to be less than or equal to 2

check=greater_than
outcome=violation
message=Expected 2 to be greater than 3

check=greater_than_or_equal
outcome=violation
message=Expected 2 to be greater than or equal to 3
